label: Masked history sensing
title: Can visible history reveal a hidden cell?
summary: With one known cell hidden on a 12-cell Rule-54 ring, 48 source fibers are ambiguous at the first snapshot, 24 after one update and none after two. A four-step target question and full source recovery resolve together on this fixed 52-state family.
takeaway: Time can reveal a hidden distinction, but in this test the task-specific answer is no cheaper than exact source identification. Known observational erasure is distinct from unknown noise or physical repair.
